# Urban Flood Dashboard Prototype

> Dwarka pilot prototype for exploring Open-Meteo forecast-model precipitation, schematic drainage geometry, and unvalidated model depth estimates. This is not an operational warning or road-safety service.

## Project files
- `src/index.html`: responsive dashboard with Simple View, Technical View, and OpenStreetMap context map.
- `src/main.py`: local HTTP server and prototype API.
- `README.md`: run instructions and current data sources.
- `DATA_PROVENANCE_AUDIT.md`: data and model provenance findings.

## API
- `GET /api/v1/nowcast?mode=live&lead_time_mins=60&zone=pilot`: forecast input and unvalidated estimate, or an unavailable response.
- `GET /api/v1/drainage-network`: schematic pilot graph with explicit provenance metadata.
- `POST /api/v1/route/flood-safe`: optional route geometry with nearby unvalidated model estimates; it does not certify safety.
- `POST /api/v1/alert-broadcast`: local preview only; no message is sent.

Forecast-mode precipitation comes from the Open-Meteo Forecast API. There is no connected local radar, rain gauge, water-level sensor, or independently validated local depth dataset. Demo mode uses fixed synthetic scenarios.
